decisions.reason: As a newly launched product very close to the core packaging range and given dedicated website presentation, a large firm with some organisational slack would likely keep it while learning unless clear underperformance emerges.

Because this valve directly builds on the established bulk-container business, uses existing capabilities, and is already presented as a standalone offer, management would be inclined to retain it absent strong evidence that it falls below aspirations.

Although its lighter website presence suggests more uncertainty, the take-back service fits the firm's strategic move toward reusable service-based packaging, so management would likely continue it for now while monitoring whether results justify the extra operational effort.
